task.target: Unable to pay hypothetical400USD emergency expense by any listed means

input_units.shock: no paid/profit work lastmonth (D1A0) binary, not jobloss

task.timing_contract: Contemporaneous2025 household survey association. No future distress observation and no income intervention.
task.calibration: Development states only; five whole-state hash folds. No held-state outcomes/calibration. EF3 other response checkboxes and EF1 savings coverage excluded to avoid near-endpoint restatement.
task.independent_unit: Respondents nested in whole states; source respondents may share unreported household/environmental dependencies. States not independent populations.
task.scope_limits: Positive-weight complete cases, state-balanced within-state survey-weighted predictive risk; not national prevalence or causal financial access. Income proxy upper bracket175k is a modeling convention. D1A0 reflects no paid work, not unemployment or a job-loss shock.

exposure.schema: Schema and source codebook aggregate tabulations inspected; no reserved respondent target or confirmation metric inspected. Source-aware public survey.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
